svg.title: ACORN browser and Tauri desktop design preview
svg.desc: Latest proposed shared ACORN workspace in a dark Tauri desktop window and light browser phone layout, closely following the OKF Plan Browser structure. It uses repository ACORN artwork, ORNL-green highlights, icon-rich navigation, theme selection, version and runtime display, guided tour, bounded native file dialogs, local file and drop entry points, all eight tools, honest WebMCP state, notifications, and a made-with-heart footer.
svg.text: ACORN Workspace · Browser + Tauri desktop · v0.6.3 · 2026-11-07
